now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In season 7, at Piper's request, Fitz and Simmons rebuild Davis as a Life Model Decoy, and a year later he drives her on missions.

changes.evidence: In 'What We're Fighting For' (season 7 finale), Fitz and Simmons build a Life Model Decoy of Davis for Piper, restore his mind into it, and one year later he is an active S.H.I.E.L.D. agent driving Piper on missions. The record itself shows this return, so 'Deceased' is wrong for where season 7 leaves him.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 122, Izel recreates Flint from Mack and Elena's memories and possesses him to rebuild the Monoliths.

proposed.text: In episode 122, the Monoliths' energy recreates Flint from Mack and Elena's fears, and Izel possesses him to rebuild the Monoliths.

changes.evidence: In 'From the Ashes' (S6E11) Flint suddenly appears in the temple; the released Monolith energy manifests him from Mack and Yo-Yo's fears, and Izel wonders why the Monoliths created him. She did not recreate him herself. In 'The Sign' (S6E12, episode 122) she possesses him to rebuild the Monoliths.
